content: patchwork 1.3.2 (CRAN, 2025-08-25): plot composition for ggplot2. Imports ggplot2 >= 3.0.0, gtable >= 0.3.6, grid, rlang, cli, farver. Suggests ragg, gt >= 0.11.0 etc. + operator for combining plots, plot_layout() for grids, plot_annotation() for titles/tags. Pure R composition; no system deps. Suitable as Suggests in a package that produces multi-panel report figures. Does not add dependencies that CRAN would flag.
